args.summary: checkout-api deployed version v2.3.1 was failing health checks in production (18% error rate) across all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rolled back v2.3.1 to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Rollout confirmed successful across all production regions. Root cause of the v2.3.1 failure remains to be investigated.
args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions taken:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: checkout-api was running v2.3.1, which was unhealthy with an 18% error rate across all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). v2.3.0 was identified as the most recent release that had been healthy in production.

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all production regions. Confirmed the rollback resolved the issue — service is now healthy with a 0.2% error rate.

3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0") describing the failure and the rollback. The on-call engineer has been paged.

Note: the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure still needs investigation — that's noted in the incident summary.
